Name: Claude Code
Author: Karim Dhanji
Description: Live status for Claude Code desktop sessions, with a key and a dial for each session, answers to questions, plans and approvals, saved prompts and mode changes.

Actions.Name: Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to scroll through the running Claude Code sessions: status, context, model and effort. Press or tap to jump to one and make it the target.

Actions.Name: Mode
Actions.Tooltip: The target session's mode, model and effort. Turn to choose Manual, Accept edits, Plan or Auto; press or tap to apply it.

Actions.Name: Approve
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the oldest request waiting for permission, across sessions. Press to allow it. A question or a plan jumps to its session.

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the oldest request waiting for permission, across sessions. Press to deny it, which stops the turn like the app's own No. A question or a plan jumps to its session.

Actions.Name: Saved Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Sends its text to the target session as your own message. A busy session gets it when its turn ends.

Actions.Name: Mode Key
Actions.Tooltip: Changes the target session to the mode set in the key's settings.

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: The target session's title and status. Press to jump to it.

Actions.Name: Session Slot
Actions.Tooltip: One session per key: its state, title, context and what it's doing. Press to jump to it; hold to put the session on screen in the app on this key. On a dial, the session on the key above: turn to page or pick, press or tap to jump or send.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Page details or pick an answer

Actions.Name: Other Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: How many sessions on no Session Slot need you. Press to jump to the one that has waited longest.
